description: Decide one of the authenticated user's historical application reviews. Sending requires fresh job-level Apply permission: NeverApply will tailor documents, answer questions using the current profile and saved preferences, and submit this named job to the employer for one credit. Before calling with send, tell the member that this call submits the application to the employer, show the job and this scope, then set job_approved only after explicit agreement. An old exact-review approval or saved answer is insufficient. Dismiss closes the review without applying.

decision.description: send queues the real submission after reserving the required credit; dismiss closes the unsubmitted review; waiting reviews hold no credit.

job_approved.description: True only after fresh explicit agreement to this decision on the named job. Sending permits tailored documents, automatic answers and submission using the current profile. Required for send and dismiss.

review_version.description: The exact review_version shown to the user by get_application.

run_id.description: The application_runs id of the hold, from get_application.

name: approve_application

status.description: queued: the submit run is queued; dismissed: the review was closed without submission; listing_closed: the posting had closed, so nothing was sent and the credit returned.

submit_run_id.description: The queued submit run when the decision was send; null otherwise.

title: Approve an application
